title: III: Stylistic Delivery and Arrangement Techniques
description: Book III of Aristotle's Rhetoric covers style, word choice, and speech arrangement. Out of scope for this showcase.
markdown:
# III: Stylistic Delivery and Arrangement Techniques

Book III moves from argument to expression: word choice, metaphor, and
sentence structure (style), then how to organize the parts of a speech
(arrangement). Delivery gets a brief mention, with the reader pointed
elsewhere in Aristotle's work for the fuller treatment.

This showcase converts [Book I](/rhetoric/book-one/) only — Book III's
chapters are out of scope here. This page is a landing only, so the section
stays navigable without dangling links.

Back to the [Rhetoric hub](/rhetoric/).
